test_cases.title: OBU evaluates information validity based on crossing direction in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train is moving in the nominal direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group information valid for the reverse direction (opposite to train orientation).

steps.action: Pass a balise group that transmits information valid only for the reverse direction (opposite to the current train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information because it is valid only for the opposite direction relative to the crossing direction (which is nominal in this case, but the requirement says 'crossing direction' vs 'train orientation'. In SL mode, if moving nominal, crossing is nominal. If info is valid for reverse, it is ignored. Wait, requirement says: 'evaluate... against the direction in which the referenced balise group is crossed'. If train moves nominal, crossing is nominal. Info valid for reverse is ignored. Let's test the case where it SHOULD be accepted: Info valid for nominal direction while moving nominal in SL mode.)

steps.action: Pass a balise group that transmits information valid for the nominal direction (same as train orientation and crossing direction).
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

steps.action: Pass a balise group that transmits information valid for the reverse direction (opposite to train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information.

test_cases.title: OBU evaluates information validity based on crossing direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train is moving in the reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group information valid for the reverse direction.

steps.action: Pass a balise group that transmits information valid for the reverse direction (same as train orientation and crossing direction).
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account.

steps.action: Pass a balise group that transmits information valid for the nominal direction (opposite to train orientation).
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information.

test_cases.title: OBU retains MA request parameters until new ones are received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: repetition enabled, period 10s. Last MA request was sent 5 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: repetition enabled, period 20s.

steps.action: Wait for 5 seconds (total 10s since last request) without receiving new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request according to the old parameters (10s period).

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 20s.
steps.expected: The OBU updates its internal parameters to the new values.

steps.action: Wait for 10 seconds after receiving the new parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request, as the new period is 20s and only 10s have passed since the last request.

test_cases.title: OBU sends immediate MA request if new parameters trigger immediate repetition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. OBU has received MA request parameters from RBC: repetition enabled, period 10s. Last MA request was sent 15 seconds ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: repetition enabled, period 10s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from RBC with a repetition period of 10s.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the time since the last MA request (15s) with the new repetition period (10s). Since 15s >= 10s, the OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.test_inputs: MA with LOA.

steps.action: Receive an MA that includes a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed greater than zero.
steps.expected: The OBU supervises the LOA.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for Supervised Location (SvL) while the LOA is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any SvL (e.g., no Danger Point or End of Overlap is used as SvL) as long as the LOA is being supervised.

steps.expected: The OBU applies the 50 km/h restriction.

steps.action: Receive a new signalling related speed restriction of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: OBU keeps Level 1 signalling speed restriction valid after switching to Level 2 until Level 2 MA accepted

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt upon safe radio connection loss

test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts continue until session termination

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts attempting to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure of the first reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate a failure of the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to repeat the attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Allow the defined time for session termination to expire without successful reconnection.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts and considers the communication session as terminated.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop upon successful connection

steps.action: Simulate a successful establishment of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU stops the reconnection attempts as the safe radio connection is obtained.

test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to stop requests for reasons other than successful setup (e.g., session termination order).

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the loss.

steps.action: Ensure the requests to set up a safe radio connection are stopped for a reason other than successful setup.
steps.expected: The indication status on the driver display changes to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Indication status changes to Connection Lost/Set-Up failed upon connection loss in radio hole
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in 'Connection Up' state. The train is approaching an announced radio hole.
test_cases.assumptions: The train position and radio hole boundaries are known.

steps.action: Move the train such that the engine (front and rear ends) overlaps the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: The safe radio connection is lost.

steps.action: Observe the driver display.
steps.expected: The indication status changes to 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed'.

test_cases.title: Connection status timer starts on first request for session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in 'No Connection' state. Start of Mission procedure is ongoing (Level 2).
test_cases.assumptions: The internal state of the connection status timer can be observed or inferred from behavior.

steps.action: Trigger the Start of Mission procedure which initiates the first request to set up a safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the first request to set up the safe radio connection.

steps.action: Verify the connection status timer state.
steps.expected: The connection status timer is started (running).

test_cases.title: Connection status timer starts on first request for session maintenance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has an established communication session. The safe radio connection is lost.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to attempt to re-establish the connection upon loss.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the loss.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the first request to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Verify the connection status timer state.
steps.expected: The connection status timer is started (running).

test_cases.title: Indication status for RIU reflects current infill area
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has safe radio connections with two different RIUs (RIU-A and RIU-B). The train is currently in the infill area of RIU-A.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of maintaining multiple RIU sessions and tracking the current infill area.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status.
steps.expected: The indication status reflects the status of the connection with RIU-A (e.g., 'Connection Up' if RIU-A connection is active).

steps.action: Move the train into the infill area of RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the current infill area to RIU-B.

steps.action: Observe the driver display for the safe radio connection status.
steps.expected: The indication status now reflects the status of the connection with RIU-B.

test_cases.title: Revalidation of train position upon passing LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'invalid' (e.g., after power-off without revalidation). An LRBG compliant balise group is ahead of the train.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the LRBG. The LRBG is correctly identified by the OBU.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status in the OBU diagnostic interface.
steps.expected: The train position status is displayed as 'invalid'.

steps.action: Move the train until it passes the LRBG compliant balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the passage of the LRBG.

steps.action: Check the train position status and the stored position data in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train position status changes to 'valid'. The previously stored invalid position data is deleted and replaced with the new position relative to the LRBG.

test_cases.title: Revalidation of train position upon passing ORBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on. The train position status is 'unknown' (no LRBG or ORBG stored). An ORBG (e.g., a previously reported LRBG) is ahead of the train.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving towards the ORBG. The ORBG is correctly identified by the OBU.

steps.action: Verify the current train position status in the OBU diagnostic interface.
steps.expected: The train position status is displayed as 'unknown'.

steps.action: Move the train until it passes the ORBG.
steps.expected: The OBU detects the passage of the ORBG.

steps.action: Check the train position status and the stored position data in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train position status changes to 'valid'. A valid train position relative to the ORBG is stored on-board.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by active cab
test_cases.preconditions: The train consists of two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab A is active. The train is in a mode where orientation is defined by the active cab (not Supervised Manoeuvre).
test_cases.assumptions: The train is moving in the direction of Cab A.

steps.action: Check the train orientation status in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined such that the front of the train is at the side of Cab A.

steps.action: Deactivate Cab A and activate Cab B.
steps.expected: The OBU registers the change in active cab.

steps.action: Check the train orientation status in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train orientation is redefined such that the front of the train is at the side of Cab B.

test_cases.title: Train orientation defined by last active cab when no cab is active
test_cases.preconditions: The train consists of two cabs (Cab A and Cab B). Cab A was the last active cab. Currently, no cab is active.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is in a mode where orientation is defined by the active/last active cab.

steps.action: Check the train orientation status in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined such that the front of the train is at the side of Cab A (the last active cab).

steps.action: Activate Cab B briefly and then deactivate it, making Cab B the last active cab.
steps.expected: The OBU registers Cab B as the last active cab.

steps.action: Check the train orientation status in the OBU.
steps.expected: The train orientation is defined such that the front of the train is at the side of Cab B.

test_cases.title: Use of estimated front end for standard location supervision
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. A location-based speed restriction (e.g., SSP) is stored on-board at a specific distance from the LRBG. The train is approaching this location.
test_cases.assumptions: The function handling the speed restriction uses the estimated front end as the reference, as no specific exception applies.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end position reaches the location of the speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the speed restriction supervision based on the estimated front end position.

steps.action: Verify the trigger point of the supervision logic in the OBU logs or diagnostic interface.
steps.expected: The supervision logic was triggered when the estimated front end crossed the restriction location, not the max safe front end or min safe rear end.

test_cases.title: Use of max safe front end for End Section timer start
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. A Movement Authority (MA) with an End Section timer start location is received. The train is approaching this location.
test_cases.assumptions: The End Section timer start location is defined in the MA.

steps.action: Move the train such that the max safe front end position reaches the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts counting.

steps.action: Verify the trigger point of the timer start in the OBU logs.
steps.expected: The timer started when the max safe front end crossed the location, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Use of min safe rear end for RBC/RBC border passage
test_cases.preconditions: The train has a valid position. The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border. The OBU is configured to send a position report when the min safe rear end passes the border.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC/RBC border location is known to the OBU.

steps.action: Move the train such that the min safe rear end position reaches the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers the event for passing the RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Verify the trigger point of the border passage event in the OBU logs.
steps.expected: The event was triggered when the min safe rear end crossed the border, not the estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with LRBG compliant balise group (Linking checked)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where linking consistency is checked. Linking information for a specific balise group (BG_L) is stored on-board and active. The train is moving towards BG_L.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_L marked as linked and contained in previously received linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: The content of the message from BG_L and all previous LRBG compliant balise groups has been taken into account by the OBU.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group BG_L.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG_L as LRBG compliant.

steps.action: The RBC requests a position report (or an event triggering a report occurs).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the LRBG identifier in the sent position report.
steps.expected: The LRBG identifier corresponds to BG_L.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with LRBG compliant balise group (Linking not checked)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where linking consistency is NOT checked. The train is moving towards a balise group (BG_U) that is not marked as unlinked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_U not marked as unlinked.
test_cases.assumptions: The content of the message from BG_U and all previous LRBG compliant balise groups has been taken into account by the OBU.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group BG_U.
steps.expected: The OBU identifies BG_U as LRBG compliant.

steps.action: The RBC requests a position report (or an event triggering a report occurs).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the LRBG identifier in the sent position report.
steps.expected: The LRBG identifier corresponds to BG_U.

test_cases.title: Position reporting with LRBG compliant balise group (Marked as unlinked)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where linking consistency is checked. The train is moving towards a balise group (BG_Unlinked) that is marked as unlinked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group BG_Unlinked marked as unlinked.
test_cases.assumptions: The content of the message from BG_Unlinked has been taken into account by the OBU.

steps.action: The train passes the balise group BG_Unlinked.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT identify BG_Unlinked as LRBG compliant.

steps.action: The RBC requests a position report (or an event triggering a report occurs).
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the LRBG identifier in the sent position report.
steps.expected: The LRBG identifier does NOT correspond to BG_Unlinked. It corresponds to the last passed LRBG compliant balise group or is set to 'unknown' if no such group exists.

test_cases.title: Accepting trackside information referring to recent LRBGs
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups (LRBG1 to LRBG8) to the RBC in sequence. The current LRBGONB is LRBG8.
test_cases.test_inputs: A message from the RBC containing location data referring to LRBG2 (one of the last 8 reported LRBGs).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a communication session with the RBC.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing location data referring to LRBG2.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the OBU regarding the received data.
steps.expected: The data is correctly associated with LRBG2 and available for use (e.g., for relocation or speed profile calculation).

test_cases.title: Accepting trackside information referring to LRBG outside the recent window
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups (LRBG1 to LRBG8) to the RBC in sequence. The current LRBGONB is LRBG8. LRBG0 was reported before LRBG1 and is no longer in the 'last 8' window.
test_cases.test_inputs: A message from the RBC containing location data referring to LRBG0.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is in a communication session with the RBC.

steps.action: The RBC sends a message containing location data referring to LRBG0.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message or ignores the location data as it refers to an LRBG outside the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs (8).

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the OBU.
steps.expected: The data referring to LRBG0 is not processed or stored as valid location data.

test_cases.title: Position reporting when no LRBG compliant balise group is passed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has no valid train position referred to an LRBG. The train passes a balise group marked as unlinked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group marked as unlinked.
test_cases.assumptions: No previous LRBG compliant balise group has been passed since the last reset or power-on.

steps.action: The train passes the unlinked balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update the LRBG reference.

steps.action: The RBC requests a position report.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report.

steps.action: Inspect the LRBG identifier in the sent position report.
steps.expected: The LRBG identifier is set to 'unknown'.

test_cases.title: Filtreleme: Tren yönüne uygun verinin kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, nominal yönde hareket etmektedir. Balise grubu, nominal yön için geçerli konum verisi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Nominal yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı.

steps.action: Tren, nominal yönde hareket ederken, nominal yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, bu veriyi kabul eder ve konum bilgisini günceller.

test_cases.title: Filtreleme: Tren yönüne aykırı verinin yok sayılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, nominal yönde hareket etmektedir. Balise grubu, ters yön için geçerli konum verisi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Ters yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı.

steps.action: Tren, nominal yönde hareket ederken, ters yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, bu veriyi yok sayar (ignore) ve mevcut konum bilgisini değiştirmez.

test_cases.title: Yön belirsizliği: Tek yönlü verinin reddedilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Tren yönü, balise grubunun yönüyle ilişkilendirilememektedir (örneğin koordinat sistemi atanmamış). Balise mesajı, sadece nominal yön için geçerli konum verisi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sadece nominal yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı.

steps.action: Yön belirsizliği durumunda, sadece nominal yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, bu veriyi reddeder (reject) ve konum bilgisini güncellemez.

test_cases.title: Yön belirsizliği: Her iki yön için geçerli verinin değerlendirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Tren yönü, balise grubunun yönüyle ilişkilendirilememektedir. Balise mesajı, her iki yön için de geçerli konum verisi içermektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Her iki yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı.

steps.action: Yön belirsizliği durumunda, her iki yön için geçerli konum verisi içeren bir balise mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, bu veriyi değerlendirir (evaluate) ve konum bilgisini günceller.

test_cases.title: Sürekli profil: Artımsal mesafelerin yorumlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, önceki bir mesajdan gelen sürekli profil verisine sahiptir (value(0) ve distance(0) tanımlı).
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir sürekli profil mesajı: value(1), distance(1), value(2), distance(2).
test_cases.assumptions: Mesafeler artımsal (incremental) olarak gönderilmektedir.

steps.action: Yeni sürekli profil mesajı okunur. value(1) ve distance(1) ile value(2) ve distance(2) içeren mesaj işlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, value(1)'in distance(1) boyunca geçerli olduğunu ve value(2)'nin distance(2) boyunca geçerli olduğunu hesaplar. distance(1), value(0) ile value(1) arasındaki mesafedir.

test_cases.title: Sürekli profil: Sıfır mesafedeki değerin kabulü
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, sürekli profil verisi işleme hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sürekli profil mesajı: value(1), distance(1)=0, value(2), distance(2)>0.

steps.action: distance(1) değeri 0 olan bir sürekli profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, value(1) değerini hâlâ dikkate alır (taken into account). Profil, value(1)'den value(2)'ye geçiş yapar.

test_cases.title: Sürekli profil: Son değerin sınırsız geçerliliği
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, sürekli profil verisi işleme hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sürekli profil mesajı: value(1), distance(1), value(2) (son değer, end-of-profile değil).
test_cases.assumptions: value(2) bir 'end of profile' değeri değildir.

steps.action: Son değeri 'end of profile' olmayan bir sürekli profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, son değeri (value(2)) sınırsız mesafe boyunca geçerli kabul eder.

test_cases.title: Konum verisi: Artımsal mesafelerin yorumlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, önceki konum verisine sahiptir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Konum verisi mesajı: value(1), distance(1), value(2), distance(2).
test_cases.assumptions: Mesafeler artımsal (incremental) olarak gönderilmektedir.

steps.action: Konum verisi mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, mesafeleri ardışık değerler arasındaki artımsal mesafeler olarak yorumlar. distance(1), önceki veri ile value(1) arasındaki mesafedir.

test_cases.title: Konum verisi: İlk mesafede önceki verinin kullanımı
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, önceki bir mesajdan gelen konum verisine sahiptir (value(0)).
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni konum verisi mesajı: value(1), distance(1).

steps.action: Yeni konum verisi mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, distance(1) aralığında (LRBG'den value(1)'e kadar) önceki veriyi (value(0)) kullanır.

test_cases.title: Sürekli olmayan profil: Elemanların yorumlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, sürekli olmayan profil verisi işleme hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sürekli olmayan profil mesajı: value(1), length(1), distance(1); value(2), length(2), distance(2).
test_cases.assumptions: Mesafeler artımsal olarak gönderilmektedir.

steps.action: Sürekli olmayan profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, her elemanı (value(n) for length(n)) yorumlar. distance(n), eleman(n) ile eleman(n-1) başlangıçları arasındaki artımsal mesafedir.

test_cases.title: Sürekli olmayan profil: Elemanların örtüşmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, sürekli olmayan profil verisi işleme hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sürekli olmayan profil mesajı: value(1), length(1)=100, distance(1)=50; value(2), length(2)=100, distance(2)=10.
test_cases.assumptions: distance(2) < length(1) olduğundan elemanlar örtüşmektedir.

steps.action: Elemanların örtüştüğü bir sürekli olmayan profil mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, elemanların örtüşebileceğini kabul eder ve veriyi reddetmez. Her eleman kendi başlangıç ve uzunluğuna göre işlenir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı bilgisi: Balise grupları arası mesafelerin yorumlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, bağlantı bilgisi (linking information) işleme hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bağlantı bilgisi mesajı: value(1), distance(1); value(2), distance(2).

steps.action: Bağlantı bilgisi mesajı okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, distance(1)'i ilk duyurulan balise grubuna kadar olan mesafe olarak, distance(2)'yi ardışık balise grupları arasındaki mesafe olarak yorumlar. Her value(n), ilgili balise grubunun bağlantı verisidir.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Linking consistency is checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking information containing a specific location accuracy value (Q_LOCACC) for Balise Group A.
test_cases.assumptions: The National Value for this area is different from the value in the linking information to ensure the correct source is used.

steps.action: Receive linking information that defines the location accuracy for Balise Group A.
steps.expected: The OBU stores the location accuracy for Balise Group A as defined in the linking information.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group A so that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the location accuracy from the linking information for the confidence interval calculation, not the National Value.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from National Value when linking is unavailable
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information is available for Balise Group B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group B with no associated linking information. National Value for location accuracy is defined for this area.
test_cases.assumptions: The Default Value is different from the National Value.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group B so that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the applicable National Value for the location accuracy of Balise Group B.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy from Default Value when no National Value applies
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. No linking information is available for Balise Group C. No National Value is defined for this area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise Group C with no associated linking information.
test_cases.assumptions: A Default Value for location accuracy is configured in the OBU.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group C so that it becomes the LRBG.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the Default Value for the location accuracy of Balise Group C.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated upon new linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group A has become LRBG and its location accuracy has been determined from initial linking information (Value X).
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information received that specifies a different location accuracy (Value Y) for Balise Group A.

steps.action: Receive new linking information that updates the location accuracy for Balise Group A to Value Y.
steps.expected: The OBU retains the original location accuracy Value X for Balise Group A and does not update it to Value Y.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when linking is no longer checked
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group A has become LRBG and its location accuracy has been determined (Value X). Linking consistency is currently checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Event causing linking consistency check to stop (e.g., entering a non-linked area).

steps.action: Trigger a condition where linking consistency is no longer checked.
steps.expected: The location accuracy for Balise Group A remains Value X and is not recalculated or changed.

test_cases.title: Location accuracy is not updated when new National Values become applicable
test_cases.preconditions: Balise Group A has become LRBG and its location accuracy has been determined (Value X).
test_cases.test_inputs: Change in train position or configuration such that a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.

steps.action: Move the train such that a new National Value for location accuracy becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The location accuracy for Balise Group A remains Value X and is not updated to the new National Value.

test_cases.title: Confidence interval calculation with standard parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Train is moving. No consist-length-related situations are active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Known location accuracy (Q_LOCACC), over-reading amount, and under-reading amount.
test_cases.assumptions: The estimated front end position is known.

steps.action: Calculate the min safe front end position.
steps.expected: The min safe front end is located in rear of the estimated front end by a distance equal to the sum of the location accuracy and the under-reading amount.

steps.action: Calculate the max safe front end position.
steps.expected: The max safe front end is located in advance of the estimated front end by a distance equal to the sum of the location accuracy and the over-reading amount.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is checked. Linking information is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise groups where Balise Group A is the reference of linking information, and Balise Group B is announced in linking information but received later.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group A (reference of linking information).
steps.expected: Balise Group A becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group B (announced in linking information).
steps.expected: Balise Group B becomes the new SOLR, replacing Balise Group A.

test_cases.title: SOLR selection while linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: Linking consistency is not checked.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of balise groups A and B.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group A.
steps.expected: Balise Group A becomes the SOLR.

steps.action: Pass Balise Group B.
steps.expected: Balise Group B becomes the new SOLR, as it is the last received balise group.

test_cases.title: Order of operations for linking information reception
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information that changes the SOLR to Balise Group B.

steps.action: Receive new linking information.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the linking replacement rule (SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1 m)) first.

steps.action: Update the SOLR based on the new linking information.
steps.expected: The SOLR is updated to Balise Group B after the replacement rule has been applied.

test_cases.title: Order of operations for non-linking information relocation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. Current SOLR is Balise Group A. Location based information is referred to Balise Group C.
test_cases.test_inputs: New location based information referred to Balise Group C.

steps.action: Receive new location based information referred to Balise Group C.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the information to the current SOLR (Balise Group A) first.

steps.action: Apply the corresponding replacement rule of §3.7.3.1.
steps.expected: The replacement rule is applied after the relocation to the SOLR.

test_cases.title: Processing location based information into location items
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Location based information (e.g., EOA) that can be defined with up to three location items.

steps.action: Receive location based information.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the information into up to three location items: 'min', 'estimated', and 'max'.

steps.action: Check the application of clauses associated with specific location item types.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the correct clause using the corresponding location item type as defined in SUBSET-026 Table 2a.

test_cases.title: Relocation using linking information
test_cases.preconditions: Current SOLR is Balise Group A. Location based information is referred to Balise Group B. Linking information is available between A and B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Linking distance between Balise Group A and Balise Group B.

steps.action: Balise Group B becomes the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location items by subtracting the linking distance between Balise Group A and Balise Group B from their distances.

test_cases.title: Relocation using travelled distance
test_cases.preconditions: Current SOLR is Balise Group A. Location based information is referred to Balise Group B. No linking information is available between A and B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Estimated, min, and max travelled distances between Balise Group A and Balise Group B.

steps.action: Balise Group B becomes the new SOLR.
steps.expected: The OBU relocates the location items by subtracting the estimated, min, or max travelled distance between Balise Group A and Balise Group B from their distances, depending on the location item type.

test_cases.title: Position report triggered by reaching standstill

test_cases.title: Geographical position display activation and deactivation by driver

steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled from reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received geographical position information defining a track kilometre reference at a specific balise group with an offset of 0 meters. The train is positioned exactly at this balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre reference value is 10.000 km. The offset is 0 m. The train moves forward in the direction of increasing track kilometre.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position while the train is at the reference balise group.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position is 10.000 km.

steps.action: The train travels 100 meters forward from the reference balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the 100 meters travelled to the reference value.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position is 10.100 km (10.000 km + 100 m).

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with non-zero offset
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received geographical position information defining a track kilometre reference at a specific balise group with an offset of 50 meters. The train is positioned exactly at this balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre reference value is 20.000 km. The offset is 50 m. The train moves forward in the direction of increasing track kilometre.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position while the train is at the reference balise group.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position is 20.050 km (20.000 km + 50 m offset).

steps.action: The train travels 50 meters forward from the reference balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the 50 meters travelled to the reference value plus offset.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed geographical position is 20.100 km (20.000 km + 50 m offset + 50 m travelled).

test_cases.title: Supervision of Roll Away distance using estimated travelled distance

test_cases.title: MA rejection due to incomplete SSP/gradient coverage (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a level where MA is accepted (e.g., Level 2). The train is moving or stationary with a valid position estimate. The OBU has no existing SSP/gradient data for the upcoming route segment.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-infill MA message from RBC/Balise where the SSP and gradient data provided covers only 50% of the distance from the estimated train front end to the Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for a non-infill MA is defined as the distance from the estimated front end of the train to the supervised location (SvL).

steps.action: Send a non-infill MA to the OBU where the accompanying SSP and gradient data does not cover the full length from the estimated train front end to the SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA. The previous MA (if any) remains valid, or the OBU enters a safe state if no previous MA exists. The new MA is not stored as the active MA.

steps.action: Verify the OBU status and stored MA data.
steps.expected: The OBU does not update its supervision limit to the new SvL. The driver interface may indicate an error or maintain the previous state.

test_cases.title: MA rejection due to incomplete SSP/gradient coverage (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. A valid MA is currently stored. The train is approaching the infill location reference (balise group at the next main signal).
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message where the SSP and gradient data covers only a portion of the distance from the infill location reference to the new Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'full length' for an infill MA is defined as the distance from the infill location reference to the supervised location (SvL).

steps.action: Send an infill MA to the OBU where the accompanying SSP and gradient data does not cover the full length from the infill location reference to the SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the infill MA. The previously stored MA remains valid and unchanged.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU has not updated the MA section beyond the infill location reference.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to supervise the train based on the previous MA data.

test_cases.title: MA acceptance with complete SSP/gradient coverage
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 2. The train is moving or stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-infill MA message where the SSP and gradient data covers the entire distance from the estimated train front end to the SvL.

steps.action: Send a non-infill MA to the OBU where the accompanying SSP and gradient data covers the full length from the estimated train front end to the SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the MA. The new MA becomes the active MA, and the supervision limit is updated to the new SvL.

steps.action: Verify the OBU status.
steps.expected: The OBU operates normally under the new MA constraints.

test_cases.title: MA rejection when existing on-board SSP/gradient is insufficient
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has existing SSP and gradient data stored on-board that covers a certain distance. The train is positioned such that the existing data does not extend to the new SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-infill MA message that does not include new SSP/gradient data, relying on the existing on-board data. The existing on-board data ends before the new SvL.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement states that SSP and gradient 'already on board or received together with the MA' must cover the full length. If the MA does not provide new data, the existing data must be sufficient.

steps.action: Send a non-infill MA to the OBU that does not contain new SSP/gradient data, where the existing on-board SSP/gradient data does not cover the full length from the estimated train front end to the new SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the MA because the combined available data (existing + new) does not cover the full length.

steps.action: Verify the OBU status.
steps.expected: The previous MA remains valid.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Static Speed Profile from start location

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A perturbation location is defined. The train is moving towards the calculated trigger location (d_MAR).
test_cases.assumptions: The train speed and acceleration are such that the calculated trigger location is ahead of the current train front.

steps.action: Move the train so that its front passes the calculated location d_MAR (perturbation location minus braking distance/time).
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reason field of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The reason is 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A Section timer is active and supervised. The defined time before expiration is set.

steps.action: Wait until the time remaining on the Section timer equals the defined triggering time criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers and sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reason field of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The reason is 'Time before a Section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached'.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session is established. Track description data is stored on-board.
test_cases.assumptions: The deletion scenario corresponds to a situation in Appendix A.3.4 that is NOT a, b, f, or k (e.g., deletion due to new MA reception that shortens the track description).

steps.action: Simulate a track description deletion event that falls under a valid situation (not a, b, f, k) as per Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the reason field of the sent MA request.
steps.expected: The reason is 'Track description deletion'.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by track description deletion (excluded situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session is established. Track description data is stored on-board.
test_cases.assumptions: The deletion scenario corresponds to situation 'a' in Appendix A.3.4 (e.g., deletion of track description beyond the LOA which is not relevant for supervision).

steps.action: Simulate a track description deletion event that falls under situation 'a' of Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

test_cases.title: End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an End Section timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with End Section timer start location at distance D ahead of max safe front end.

steps.action: Move the train so that the max safe front end is just before the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer is not running.

steps.action: Move the train so that the max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location.
steps.expected: The End Section timer starts running.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout actions
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. The current MA has a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value.

steps.action: Allow the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The EOA/LOA is withdrawn to the train's current position. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 operation. A new MA with a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message with a specific time stamp T_msg.

steps.action: Receive the MA message containing the LOA speed.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the time stamp T_msg of the message.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 operation. A balise group giving an MA with a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority is ahead.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train passes the first balise of the balise group.

steps.action: Pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The LOA speed timer starts at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout actions
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. The current MA has a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority (LOA).
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value.

steps.action: Allow the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value received from trackside.
steps.expected: The speed associated with the LOA is set to zero. The LOA becomes an EOA. The Supervised Location is defined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap timer start location at distance D ahead of max safe front end.

steps.action: Move the train so that the max safe front end is just before the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is not running.

steps.action: Move the train so that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer starts running.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A valid MA with an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train and a time-out value of 'infinite' is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA with Overlap time-out value set to 'infinite'.

steps.action: Move the train so that the max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The Overlap timer is considered as started.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout actions
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The current MA has an overlap with a release speed and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: Wait for the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value.

steps.action: Allow the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value given by trackside.
steps.expected: The overlap information is deleted. The release speed associated with the Overlap is deleted. The Supervised Location is redetermined per §3.8.4.5. The location based information listed in Appendix A.3.4 is deleted. The target speed at the End of Movement Authority is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expiration upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. The train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Bring the train to a standstill.

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Overlap timer as expired. The consequences defined for Overlap time-out in §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: New MA with Overlap start location in rear of max safe front end (no timer running)
test_cases.preconditions: No Overlap timer is running. The train is positioned such that its max safe front end is ahead of the Overlap timer start location in the new MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA with Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end.

steps.action: Receive a new MA with an Overlap timer start location in rear of the max safe front end of the train.
steps.expected: The OBU considers that the Overlap timer has exceeded its time-out value. The consequences defined in §3.8.4.4.2 are applied (overlap deleted, release speed deleted, SvL redetermined, target speed set to zero).

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with valid overlap
test_cases.preconditions: The current MA includes an overlap that has not timed out. A Danger Point and End Section are also defined.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) defined on-board.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the overlap.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with timed-out overlap and Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: The overlap has timed out and been deleted. A Danger Point is defined in the MA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) defined on-board.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the Danger Point.

test_cases.title: Supervised Location determination with no overlap and no Danger Point
test_cases.preconditions: No overlap exists (or it has timed out). No Danger Point is defined in the MA. An End Section is defined.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) defined on-board.
steps.expected: The SvL is set to the end of the End Section.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Full Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA received.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Full Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The infill MA is evaluated on-board.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Automatic Driving mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Automatic Driving (AD) mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA received.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Automatic Driving mode.
steps.expected: The infill MA is evaluated on-board.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation in Limited Supervision mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Limited Supervision (LS) mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA received.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in Limited Supervision mode.
steps.expected: The infill MA is evaluated on-board.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection in other modes
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode other than FS, AD, or LS (e.g., SB or SH). Linking information for the main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA received.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA while in a mode other than FS, AD, or LS.
steps.expected: The infill MA is not evaluated on-board.

test_cases.title: Infill MA evaluation with available linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group referenced by the infill MA is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA received.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA for which linking information is available.
steps.expected: The infill MA is evaluated on-board.

test_cases.title: Infill MA rejection without linking information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Linking information for the main signal balise group referenced by the infill MA is NOT available.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA received.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA for which linking information is not available.
steps.expected: The infill MA is not evaluated on-board.

test_cases.title: Full MA replacement upon receiving non-infill MA from RBC
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored a previous MA with specific section lengths and speed profiles.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message from the RBC with different section lengths and speed profiles than the stored MA.

steps.action: Transmit a new MA from the RBC to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (sections, speeds, etc.) are replaced by the data of the new MA. No remnants of the previous MA remain.

test_cases.title: Full MA replacement upon receiving non-infill MA from main-signal balise
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored a previous MA. The train is approaching a main signal balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group message at a main signal containing a new non-infill MA with different parameters than the stored MA.

steps.action: Pass the main signal balise group transmitting the new non-infill MA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA are replaced by the data of the new MA.

test_cases.title: Partial MA replacement upon receiving infill MA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored a previous MA. The linking information for the next main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message referring to the next main signal balise group, with different data for sections beyond that point.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the stored MA data in the OBU.
steps.expected: Data up to the announced balise group at the next main signal remain unchanged from the previous MA. Data beyond that point are replaced by the new infill MA data.

test_cases.title: Start new MA section at infill location reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored a previous MA. The linking information for the next main signal balise group is available.
test_cases.test_inputs: An infill MA message referring to the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Receive the infill MA message.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA.

steps.action: Inspect the structure of the stored MA sections.
steps.expected: A new MA section starts at the infill location reference (the balise group at the next main signal). The section before this reference remains from the previous MA.

test_cases.title: MA shortening when new MA defines SvL while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) and has stored location-based information beyond the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message that defines a Supervised Location (SvL) (e.g., an End of Authority with a stop signal).

steps.action: Receive the new MA defining an SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: Location-based information stored beyond the new SvL is deleted, as per Appendix A.3.4.

test_cases.title: MA shortening when new MA defines SvL closer than previous SvL
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is supervising an SvL and has stored location-based information beyond this SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message defining an SvL that is closer to the train than the previously supervised SvL.

steps.action: Receive the new MA with a closer SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats this as an MA shortening.

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information.
steps.expected: Location-based information stored beyond the new, closer SvL is deleted, as per Appendix A.3.4.

test_cases.title: No MA shortening upon receiving repositioning information
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored an MA. Linking information announces a following balise group as unknown but containing repositioning information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Repositioning information from a balise group.

steps.action: Receive the repositioning information.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the length of the current MA section.

steps.action: Check if the OBU triggers MA shortening procedures.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted due to shortening.

test_cases.title: No MA shortening upon receiving new MA ending with LOA
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode and has stored an MA with an SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new MA message that ends with a Limit of Authority (LOA).

steps.action: Receive the new MA ending with an LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA.

steps.action: Check if the OBU triggers MA shortening procedures.
steps.expected: The OBU does not treat this as an MA shortening. No location-based information is deleted due to shortening.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Tren ucu ISL'nin arkasında)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile tam denetim (FS) modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen yeni EOA, mevcut EOA'ya göre daha yakındır. Önerilen MA'nın İndication Supervision Limit (ISL) değeri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan daha ileridedir (tren ucu ISL'nin arkasındadır). İsteğe bağlı olarak bir Mode Profile ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi içerir.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin konumu ve hızı, önerilen ISL'nin arkasında kalmasını sağlayacak şekilde ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen ISL'nin arkasında olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder. Önerilen kısaltılmış MA, ilgili Mode Profile ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi (varsa) yeni geçerli MA olarak kabul edilir.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin reddi (Tren ucu ISL'nin önünde)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile tam denetim (FS) modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen yeni EOA, mevcut EOA'ya göre daha yakındır. Önerilen MA'nın İndication Supervision Limit (ISL) değeri, trenin tahmini ön ucundan daha geridedir (tren ucu ISL'nin önündedir).
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin konumu ve hızı, önerilen ISL'nin önünde kalmasını sağlayacak şekilde ayarlanmıştır.

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen ISL'nin önünde olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği reddeder. Önceki MA, Mode Profile ve SH alanı balise grubu listesi (varsa) geçerli kalmaya devam eder. Yeni MA kabul edilmez.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin reddedildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: MA kısaltma isteğinin kabulü (Sınır durumu: Tren ucu ISL ile aynı konumda)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA ile tam denetim (FS) modunda çalışmaktadır. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen MA'nın İndication Supervision Limit (ISL) değeri, trenin tahmini ön ucuyla aynı konumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin konumu, önerilen ISL ile tam olarak hizalanmıştır. 'In rear' (arkasında) ifadesi, sınır durumunda kabul olarak yorumlanmıştır (genellikle eşitlik kabul için yeterlidir veya güvenlik marjı gereği kabul edilir; spesifikasyon 'in rear' derken genellikle < veya <= kastedilir, ancak test senaryosunda sınır değeri kabul olarak test edilir).

steps.action: RBC'den, trenin ön ucunun önerilen ISL ile aynı konumda olduğu bir MA kısaltma isteği gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU isteği kabul eder. Önerilen kısaltılmış MA yeni geçerli MA olarak kabul edilir.

steps.action: OBU'nun RBC'ye gönderdiği yanıt mesajı gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'ye isteğin kabul edildiğini bildiren bir mesaj gönderir.

test_cases.title: OBU ignores infill announcement for unsupported medium
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is operating in Level 1. The OBU is not equipped with the specific infill transmission medium (e.g., Euroloop or Radio Infill) requested by the test scenario. The OBU has previously received valid movement authority and track description information from a supported medium (e.g., Balise).
test_cases.test_inputs: An announcement balise group message requesting an infill medium not present on the OBU (e.g., requesting Radio Infill when OBU has no Radio Infill capability).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's configuration correctly reflects the absence of the specific infill hardware. The previous information received is valid and sufficient for continued operation.

steps.action: Transmit an announcement balise group message to the OBU that requests an infill transmission medium which the OBU is not equipped with.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the announcement message. The OBU does not attempt to establish a connection or listen for data on the unsupported medium.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's internal state and driver display regarding the movement authority and track description.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to use the previously received movement authority and track description information. No error related to the missing infill medium is displayed, and the train supervision remains active based on the old data.

test_cases.title: Infill information from loop ignored after reading next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. A loop infill device is active and transmitting infill information. The next main signal balise group is identified in the infill data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill message containing movement authority data. Balise group message from the next main signal.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is correctly configured to receive loop infill data. The train is moving towards the next main signal.

steps.action: The OBU receives infill information from the loop while approaching the next main signal.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill information and updates the movement authority accordingly.

steps.action: The OBU reads the balise group at the next main signal.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the main signal balise group data.

steps.action: The loop continues to transmit infill information after the OBU has read the main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the new infill information received from the loop. The movement authority remains based on the main signal balise group data.

test_cases.title: Infill information from loop ignored after detecting missed next main signal balise group
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1 operation. A loop infill device is active and transmitting infill information. The next main signal balise group is identified in the infill data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill message containing movement authority data. Simulated condition where the main signal balise group is not read (missed).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the expected balise group was missed (e.g., based on distance/time or lack of signal).

steps.action: The OBU receives infill information from the loop while approaching the next main signal.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill information.

steps.action: The OBU passes the location of the next main signal balise group without reading it, triggering the 'missed' detection logic.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: The loop continues to transmit infill information after the OBU has detected the missed balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the new infill information received from the loop.

test_cases.title: Order to establish RIU session ignored when GSM-R is not installed
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured without a GSM-R radio system. The OBU is in Level 1 operation.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a specific RIU.

steps.action: The train passes a balise group containing an order to establish a communication session with a Radio Infill Unit.
steps.expected: The OBU does not attempt to establish a communication session with the RIU. No radio connection is initiated.

test_cases.title: Establish RIU session via balise order and terminate other sessions
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in Level 1. An existing communication session with RIU-A is active. The OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions.
test_cases.test_inputs: A balise group containing an order to establish a session with RIU-B at location L1.

steps.action: The train passes the location L1 indicated in the balise order.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing communication session with RIU-A.

steps.action: The OBU attempts to establish a new session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: A communication session with RIU-B is established.

test_cases.title: Ignore RIU order in degraded single-session mode
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a degraded situation where it can handle only one GSM-R communication session. An existing session with RIU-A is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order received via RIU-A to establish a session with RIU-B.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order via the active RIU-A session to establish a new session with RIU-B.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the order. The session with RIU-A remains active, and no session with RIU-B is established.

test_cases.title: Send entry and exit information to RIU

steps.action: The train passes the location L_start indicated in the balise order.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the RIU indicating entry into the infill area.

steps.action: The train reads the Next Main Signal Balise Group (NMBG) indicated in the order.

test_cases.title: Send missed NMBG information to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is established. The train is in the infill area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement where the NMBG is not read (missed).

steps.action: The OBU detects that the Next Main Signal Balise Group (NMBG) indicated in the order was missed.
steps.expected: The OBU sends information to the RIU indicating that the NMBG was missed.

test_cases.title: Verify content of information sent to RIU
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is established. The OBU is configured with a specific ETCS-ID.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for sending information (e.g., passing L_start).

steps.action: The OBU sends information to the RIU upon entering the infill area.
steps.expected: The message contains the OBU's ETCS-ID, a position report, the identifier of the next main signal balise group, and a time stamp.

test_cases.title: Reject inconsistent radio infill data
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is established.
test_cases.test_inputs: Radio infill data with an invalid time stamp or inconsistent position data (violating §3.16.3.1/3.16.3.3).

steps.action: The OBU receives radio infill data with an inconsistent time stamp.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the data and does not apply the infill information.

test_cases.title: Ignore infill data after NMBG is read
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has read the Next Main Signal Balise Group (NMBG) indicated in the previous order.
