steps.expected: The OBU ignores the received infill information.

test_cases.title: Terminate RIU session on trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: A termination order received from a balise group or the RIU.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order to terminate the communication session from the trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Terminate RIU session when leaving Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: A communication session with an RIU is active. The OBU is in Level 1.
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to Level 2 or Level 0.

steps.action: The OBU transitions out of Level 1 (e.g., to Level 2).
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the communication session with the RIU.

test_cases.title: Emergency message acknowledgement with correct ID
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode capable of receiving and processing emergency messages (e.g., Full Supervision). The RBC is configured to send an emergency message.
test_cases.test_inputs: An emergency message (Conditional or Unconditional) with a unique identification number (NID_EM) is sent from the RBC to the OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The communication link between RBC and OBU is stable and functional.

steps.action: Send an emergency message from the RBC to the OBU with a specific identification number (e.g., NID_EM = 100).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it according to its type (Conditional or Unconditional).

steps.action: Monitor the communication interface for the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that includes the identification number NID_EM = 100, matching the received emergency message.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of repeated emergency message with same ID
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has already received and acknowledged an emergency message with identification number NID_EM = 200.
test_cases.test_inputs: A repeated emergency message with the same identification number (NID_EM = 200) is sent from the RBC to the OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU replaces the previous message with the new one as per requirement 3.10.1.3.1, but the acknowledgement logic remains tied to the ID.

steps.action: Send a second emergency message from the RBC to the OBU with the same identification number (NID_EM = 200).
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and replaces the previous one internally.

steps.action: Monitor the communication interface for the acknowledgement message sent by the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message that includes the identification number NID_EM = 200.

test_cases.title: Acknowledgement of emergency message with different ID
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode capable of receiving emergency messages.
test_cases.test_inputs: Two distinct emergency messages with different identification numbers (NID_EM = 300 and NID_EM = 301) are sent sequentially from the RBC to the OBU.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU processes each message independently.

steps.action: Send the first emergency message with NID_EM = 300.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement containing NID_EM = 300.

steps.action: Send the second emergency message with NID_EM = 301.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement containing NID_EM = 301.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepted Conditional Emergency Stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it accepts movement authorities (e.g., Full Supervision). A Conditional Emergency Stop message with a stop location ahead of the train's minimum safe front end has been received and accepted, resulting in a new EOA/SvL with no release speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new Movement Authority (MA) message from the RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The emergency stop message has not been revoked by the RBC.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The current EOA/SvL defined by the emergency stop remains active, and the release speed remains zero.

test_cases.title: Rejection of new MA after accepted Unconditional Emergency Stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has received and accepted an Unconditional Emergency Stop message, causing the train to trip immediately.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new Movement Authority (MA) message from the RBC.
test_cases.assumptions: The emergency stop message has not been revoked by the RBC.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU while the train is in the tripped state due to the unconditional emergency stop.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new MA. The train remains in the tripped state or the emergency stop condition persists, preventing the use of the new MA.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of new MA after revocation of Emergency Stop
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has accepted an emergency stop message (Conditional or Unconditional) and is currently rejecting new MAs.
test_cases.test_inputs: 1. A revocation message for the emergency stop. 2. A new Movement Authority (MA) message.
test_cases.assumptions: The revocation message is valid and correctly formatted.

steps.action: Send a revocation message for the active emergency stop to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the revocation. The emergency stop condition is cleared.

steps.action: Send a new Movement Authority (MA) message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new MA and updates the EOA/SvL and release speed according to the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges emergency message revocation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages (e.g., Full Supervision). An active emergency message (Conditional or Unconditional) with a specific identifier has been previously received and acknowledged by the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Revocation of Emergency Stop message (Message 18) containing the identifier of the active emergency message.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio communication link between RBC and OBU is established and stable.

steps.action: Send a Revocation of Emergency Stop message (Message 18) from the RBC to the OBU, referencing the identifier of the currently active emergency message.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes the revocation.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink communication from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message (Message 147 or general acknowledgement as per §3.16.3.5) to the RBC, confirming the receipt and processing of the revocation message.

test_cases.title: OBU acknowledges revocation of non-existent emergency message
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where it can receive radio messages. No active emergency messages are currently stored in the OBU.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Revocation of Emergency Stop message (Message 18) containing an identifier for an emergency message that does not exist in the OBU's memory.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio communication link between RBC and OBU is established and stable.

steps.action: Send a Revocation of Emergency Stop message (Message 18) from the RBC to the OBU, referencing an identifier that is not currently active in the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message. Depending on implementation, it may ignore the content or log an inconsistency, but it must still process the message receipt.

steps.action: Monitor the uplink communication from the OBU to the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an acknowledgement message to the RBC, confirming the receipt of the revocation message, as per the general acknowledgement procedure in §3.16.3.5.

test_cases.title: On-Sight mode: Trackside speed limit overrides National value
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured with a National value for On-Sight speed limit (e.g., 30 km/h). The train is in On-Sight mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Mode Profile or trackside message providing an On-Sight speed limit of 20 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The National value for On-Sight speed limit is set to 30 km/h. The trackside provides a valid speed limit of 20 km/h.

steps.action: Inject a trackside message defining the On-Sight speed limit as 20 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside speed limit.

steps.action: Check the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The applied speed limit is 20 km/h, not the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Limited Supervision mode: Trackside speed limit overrides National value
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured with a National value for Limited Supervision speed limit (e.g., 100 km/h). The train is in Limited Supervision mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Mode Profile or trackside message providing a Limited Supervision speed limit of 80 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The National value for Limited Supervision speed limit is set to 100 km/h. The trackside provides a valid speed limit of 80 km/h.

steps.action: Inject a trackside message defining the Limited Supervision speed limit as 80 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside speed limit.

steps.action: Check the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The applied speed limit is 80 km/h, not the National value of 100 km/h.

test_cases.title: Shunting mode: Trackside speed limit overrides National value
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured with a National value for Shunting speed limit (e.g., 30 km/h). The train is in Shunting mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Mode Profile or trackside message providing a Shunting speed limit of 15 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The National value for Shunting speed limit is set to 30 km/h. The trackside provides a valid speed limit of 15 km/h.

steps.action: Inject a trackside message defining the Shunting speed limit as 15 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside speed limit.

steps.action: Check the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The applied speed limit is 15 km/h, not the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: On-Sight mode: Trackside speed limit higher than National value
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured with a National value for On-Sight speed limit (e.g., 30 km/h). The train is in On-Sight mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Mode Profile or trackside message providing an On-Sight speed limit of 40 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: The National value for On-Sight speed limit is set to 30 km/h. The trackside provides a valid speed limit of 40 km/h.

steps.action: Inject a trackside message defining the On-Sight speed limit as 40 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the trackside speed limit.

steps.action: Check the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The applied speed limit is 40 km/h, not the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: Shunting mode: No trackside speed limit provided, National value applied
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is configured with a National value for Shunting speed limit (e.g., 30 km/h). The train is in Shunting mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Mode Profile or trackside message that does not specify a Shunting speed limit.
test_cases.assumptions: The National value for Shunting speed limit is set to 30 km/h. The trackside does not provide a specific speed limit.

steps.action: Inject a trackside message that does not define a Shunting speed limit.
steps.expected: The OBU does not receive a trackside speed limit for Shunting mode.

steps.action: Check the applied speed limit in the OBU.
steps.expected: The applied speed limit is the National value of 30 km/h.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction calculation upon receipt of trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. No active PBD speed restriction is present.
test_cases.test_inputs: A non-continuous profile containing PBD data (start/end location, PBD distance, brake type, gradient).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows injection of trackside messages and observation of the internal speed profile.

steps.action: Inject a valid PBD profile from trackside with a permitted braking distance of 1000m, emergency brake, and 0% gradient.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates and applies a PBD speed restriction (V_PBD) greater than 0 km/h in the speed profile between the start and end locations.

steps.action: Verify the calculated V_PBD value against the expected value derived from the EBD curve reaching zero speed at 1000m.
steps.expected: The applied speed restriction matches the calculated value rounded down to the nearest multiple of 5 km/h.

test_cases.title: No recalculation when non-PBD inputs change
test_cases.preconditions: A PBD speed restriction is active based on a specific PBD profile.
test_cases.test_inputs: A change in a non-PBD input, e.g., a change in the train's current speed or a different static speed restriction unrelated to PBD.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU logs or exposes the timestamp of the last PBD calculation.

steps.action: Record the current PBD speed restriction value and calculation timestamp.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction is active and stable.

steps.action: Change a non-PBD input, such as increasing the train speed or updating an unrelated static speed restriction.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction value remains unchanged and the calculation timestamp does not update.

test_cases.title: Recalculation when PBD input changes
test_cases.preconditions: A PBD speed restriction is active based on a specific PBD profile (e.g., PBD=1000m).
test_cases.test_inputs: An updated PBD profile with a different permitted braking distance (e.g., PBD=500m).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows updating the PBD profile while it is active.

steps.action: Inject an updated PBD profile with a reduced permitted braking distance (500m) while the previous restriction (1000m) is active.
steps.expected: The OBU recalculates the PBD speed restriction.

steps.action: Verify the new PBD speed restriction value.
steps.expected: The new speed restriction is lower than or equal to the previous one, reflecting the shorter braking distance, and is rounded down to the nearest multiple of 5 km/h.

test_cases.title: PBD calculation with rotating-mass-compensated gradient
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Train data includes rotating mass parameters.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with a non-zero gradient (e.g., 2.5% uphill) and emergency brake.
test_cases.assumptions: The rotating mass compensation factor is known and can be verified in the calculation.

steps.action: Inject a PBD profile with a 2.5% uphill gradient and PBD=1000m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the PBD speed restriction using the gradient value compensated for rotating mass as per SUBSET-026 §3.13.4.3.

steps.action: Compare the calculated V_PBD with a reference calculation that includes rotating mass compensation.
steps.expected: The OBU's result matches the reference calculation, confirming the gradient was compensated correctly.

test_cases.title: PBD calculation ignoring trackside adhesion and brake-inhibition conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Trackside provides adhesion profiles and brake-inhibition track conditions.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile and trackside data including reduced adhesion and brake-inhibition zones within the PBD range.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal deceleration model can be inspected or the result compared against a model that ignores these conditions.

steps.action: Inject a PBD profile covering a zone with reduced adhesion and brake-inhibition track conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the safe deceleration ignoring the trackside adhesion profiles and brake-inhibition conditions.

steps.action: Compare the calculated V_PBD with a reference calculation that excludes adhesion and brake-inhibition effects.
steps.expected: The OBU's result matches the reference calculation, confirming these conditions were ignored.

test_cases.title: PBD calculation with zero estimated acceleration and fixed assumptions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with emergency brake.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal state for estimated acceleration, speed inaccuracy compensation, and processing delay can be verified.

steps.action: Inject a PBD profile and verify the internal state variables used for calculation.
steps.expected: The estimated acceleration is set to zero. The speed inaccuracy compensation (V_delta0PBD) is calculated based on the PBD speed. The processing delay (T41) is applied as per SUBSET-041 §5.2.1.1.

steps.action: Verify the brake feedback and traction cut-off assumptions.
steps.expected: T_bs1 and T_bs2 are defined as if service brake feedback was not implemented. T_traction is defined as if traction cut-off was not implemented.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction with emergency brake satisfying inequalities
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with emergency brake and a PBD distance that allows a non-zero speed solution.
test_cases.assumptions: The EBD curve and inequalities from SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6 are implemented correctly.

steps.action: Inject a PBD profile with emergency brake and PBD=2000m.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates a V_PBD that satisfies the EBD-based inequalities.

steps.action: Verify the rounding of the calculated V_PBD.
steps.expected: The final V_PBD is rounded down to the next lower multiple of 5 km/h.

test_cases.title: PBD speed restriction with emergency brake when no speed satisfies inequalities
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: A PBD profile with emergency brake and a very short PBD distance (e.g., 10m) that makes it impossible to satisfy the inequalities with any positive speed.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU handles the case where no speed value fulfills the inequalities by setting V_PBD to 0.

steps.action: Inject a PBD profile with emergency brake and PBD=10m.
steps.expected: The OBU determines that no speed value satisfies the EBD-based inequalities.

steps.action: Verify the resulting PBD speed restriction.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction (V_PBD) is set to 0 km/h.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A tunnel stopping area is stored on-board. The display of tunnel stopping area information is enabled. The train is moving towards the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is at the start location of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU based on current position and confidence interval. The start location of the tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is just before the start location of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is displayed, indicating the distance to the start location.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the start location of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area announcement' is no longer displayed. The 'Tunnel stopping area' information is displayed to the driver.

test_cases.title: Sound horn area start evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. A sound horn area is stored on-board. The train is moving towards the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is at the start location of the sound horn area.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'estimated front end' is calculated by the OBU. The start location of the sound horn area is defined in the track database.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is at the location (point C) determined by the OBU for the sound horn indication, which is in rear of the start of the sound horn area (point D).
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is displayed to the driver.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the start location (point D) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication remains displayed.

test_cases.title: Tunnel stopping area end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. The train is inside a tunnel stopping area. The 'Tunnel stopping area' information is currently displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is at the end location of the tunnel stopping area.
test_cases.assumptions: The end location of the tunnel stopping area is defined in the track database. The display logic follows the supervision limit calculation described in 5.18.8.3.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is in advance of the Permitted supervision limit calculated from the end location of the tunnel stopping area.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area' information is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Sound horn area end evaluation with estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in operational mode. The train is inside a sound horn area. The 'Sound horn' indication is currently displayed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data such that the estimated front end is at the end location of the sound horn area.
test_cases.assumptions: The end location of the sound horn area is defined in the track database.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches the end location (point E) of the sound horn area.
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Loading gauge mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where route suitability supervision is active (e.g., Full Supervision). Valid Train Data is stored on-board with a specific loading gauge (e.g., 'G1').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of accepted loading gauges that does NOT include the train's stored loading gauge ('G1').
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside sends route suitability data as location data.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU where the list of accepted loading gauges excludes the train's current loading gauge.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an unsuitability regarding the loading gauge.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's reaction to the unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the closest location corresponding to the unsuitability as a temporary EOA and SvL with no Release Speed. The driver is informed about the loading gauge unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Axle load category mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where route suitability supervision is active. Valid Train Data is stored on-board with a specific axle load category (e.g., 'A').
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a list of permitted axle load categories that does NOT include the train's stored axle load category ('A').

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU where the list of permitted axle load categories excludes the train's current axle load category.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an unsuitability regarding the axle load category.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's reaction to the unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the closest location corresponding to the unsuitability as a temporary EOA and SvL with no Release Speed. The driver is informed about the axle load category unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: Traction system mismatch
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where route suitability supervision is active. Valid Train Data is stored on-board with a specific traction system accepted by the engine (e.g., 'Electric 25kV'). The engine is NOT capable of running on a line without any traction system.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a traction system (e.g., 'Diesel') that is NOT among those accepted by the engine.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU where the traction system received is not in the list of traction systems accepted by the engine.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and identifies an unsuitability regarding the traction system.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's reaction to the unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the closest location corresponding to the unsuitability as a temporary EOA and SvL with no Release Speed. The driver is informed about the traction system unsuitability.

test_cases.title: Route suitability check: All parameters match
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where route suitability supervision is active. Valid Train Data is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside where the train's loading gauge, axle load category, and traction system are all included in the respective lists provided by trackside.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside to the OBU where all train parameters match the permitted values.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data and finds no unsuitability.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's state.
steps.expected: No temporary EOA or SvL is created due to route suitability. The train continues to be supervised by the regular EOA and SvL.

test_cases.title: Traction system unsuitability exception: Engine can run without traction
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where route suitability supervision is active. The engine is configured/capable to run on a line not fitted with any traction system. Valid Train Data is stored.
test_cases.test_inputs: Route suitability data from trackside containing a traction system that is NOT among those accepted by the engine (e.g., trackside specifies 'Electric', engine accepts 'Diesel' but can also run on 'None').
test_cases.assumptions: The engine's capability to run without traction is correctly reflected in the OBU's logic/configuration.

steps.action: Send route suitability data from trackside where the traction system does not match the engine's accepted list, but the engine is capable of running without traction.
steps.expected: The OBU compares the data.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's reaction regarding traction system unsuitability.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT identify a traction system unsuitability. No temporary EOA or SvL is created due to traction system mismatch.

test_cases.title: No route suitability data received: Initial state
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where route suitability supervision is active. No route suitability data has been received from trackside yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: None (absence of data).

steps.action: Operate the train in an area where trackside does not send any route suitability data.
steps.expected: The OBU allows the train to run.

steps.action: Check the OBU's internal state for route suitability restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU does not use or supervise any default route suitability values. The state is 'no route suitability restriction exists'.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for auxiliary information without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed. A valid text message is prepared with class 'auxiliary' and acknowledgement 'not requested'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Class=Auxiliary, Ack=No, Start=Immediate, End=Time(10s).
test_cases.assumptions: The visual appearance (e.g., color, font, icon) for 'auxiliary/no-ack' is distinct from 'important/ack' as defined in the HMI specification.

steps.action: Transmit the text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The message is displayed on the DMI with the visual appearance corresponding to 'auxiliary information' and 'no acknowledgement requested'.

test_cases.title: Display appearance for important information with acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where text messages are displayed. A valid text message is prepared with class 'important' and acknowledgement 'requested'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Class=Important, Ack=Yes, Start=Immediate, End=Time(10s).
test_cases.assumptions: The visual appearance for 'important/ack' is distinct from 'auxiliary/no-ack'.

steps.action: Transmit the text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The message is displayed on the DMI with the visual appearance corresponding to 'important information' and 'acknowledgement requested'.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (OR logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode different from Mode A. Train is located before Location X.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Start Condition = (Location X OR Mode A), Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0 (OR logic). End Condition = Time(10s).
test_cases.assumptions: Q_TEXTDISPLAY=0 means 'display as soon as one of the sub-conditions is fulfilled'.

steps.action: Transmit the text message.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed yet.

steps.action: Move the train front end past Location X while remaining in the current mode.
steps.expected: The message is displayed immediately, as one of the start sub-conditions (Location) is fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Start condition with multiple sub-conditions (AND logic)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode different from Mode A. Train is located before Location X.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Start Condition = (Location X AND Mode A), Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1 (AND logic). End Condition = Time(10s).
test_cases.assumptions: Q_TEXTDISPLAY=1 means 'display as soon as all sub-conditions are fulfilled'.

steps.action: Transmit the text message.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed.

steps.action: Move the train front end past Location X.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed, as Mode A is not active.

steps.action: Transition the OBU to Mode A.
steps.expected: The message is displayed, as both sub-conditions (Location and Mode) are now fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Start condition with no sub-conditions defined
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Start Condition = None (empty list). End Condition = Time(10s).

steps.action: Transmit the text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The message is displayed immediately upon reception, as the start condition is considered fulfilled immediately.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement ends display regardless of end condition
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Ack=Yes, Ack_Ends_Display=Always (Option a). End Condition = Time(60s).
test_cases.assumptions: The message parameter allows defining if ack always ends display.

steps.action: Transmit the text message.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Wait for 10 seconds (end condition not yet fulfilled).
steps.expected: The message is still displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The message display ends immediately, even though the time-based end condition (60s) has not been fulfilled.

test_cases.title: Driver acknowledgement is necessary condition for ending display
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a valid operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Ack=Yes, Ack_Ends_Display=Necessary (Option b). End Condition = Time(10s).
test_cases.assumptions: The message parameter allows defining if ack is a necessary condition in addition to end condition.

steps.action: Transmit the text message.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Wait for 15 seconds (end condition fulfilled).
steps.expected: The message is still displayed, as driver acknowledgement has not been given.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The message display ends, as both the end condition and the acknowledgement are fulfilled.

test_cases.title: No display if end condition is immediately fulfilled
test_cases.preconditions: Train is located past Location Y. OBU is in a valid operational mode.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Start Condition = Location X (train is past X). End Condition = Location Y (train is past Y).
test_cases.assumptions: Location X is behind the train, Location Y is also behind the train.

steps.action: Transmit the text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The message is not displayed at all, because the end condition is already fulfilled when the start condition is evaluated.

test_cases.title: Display length measured from start location
test_cases.preconditions: Train is located before Location A. OBU is in Mode B.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: Start Condition = (Location A AND Mode B). End Condition = Location C (where C is 100m after A).
test_cases.assumptions: The 'length' of display is defined by the distance between the start location and the end location.

steps.action: Transmit the text message.
steps.expected: Message is not displayed.

steps.action: Move train past Location A while in Mode B.
steps.expected: Message is displayed.

steps.action: Move train past Location C.
steps.expected: Message display ends. The total distance over which the message was displayed corresponds to the distance between Location A and Location C.

test_cases.title: Report driver acknowledgement to RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and connected to RBC. A text message with ID 'MSG-123' and Q_TEXTREPORT=1 is transmitted.
test_cases.test_inputs: Text message: ID=MSG-123, Q_TEXTREPORT=1, RBC_ID=RBC-1.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC is monitoring the uplink for acknowledgement reports.

steps.action: Transmit the text message to the OBU.
steps.expected: The message is displayed.

steps.action: Driver acknowledges the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a driver acknowledgement report to RBC-1 containing the text message identifier 'MSG-123'.

test_cases.title: Reject duplicate text message ID with pending acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has received a text message with ID 'MSG-456' and Q_TEXTREPORT=1. The driver has NOT yet acknowledged this message.
test_cases.test_inputs: New text message: ID=MSG-456, Q_TEXTREPORT=1.

steps.action: Transmit the new text message with ID 'MSG-456' to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the new message. The original message with ID 'MSG-456' remains displayed and pending acknowledgement.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with OS Mode Profile: Deletion beyond reference location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A valid OS Mode Profile is currently supervised. The train is located before the infill reference location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new OS Mode Profile. Infill reference location is defined.
test_cases.assumptions: The infill reference location is within the current OS Mode Profile area.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA that includes a new OS Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the infill MA. The existing OS Mode Profile is retained up to the infill reference location.

steps.action: Check the state of the Mode Profile beyond the infill reference location.
steps.expected: The OS Mode Profile is deleted beyond the infill reference location. The new OS Mode Profile from the infill MA is applied beyond this location.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with SH Mode Profile: Infill reference at or in rear of SH start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A valid SH Mode Profile is currently supervised. The train is located before the SH Mode Profile start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new SH Mode Profile. Infill reference location is at or in rear of the current SH Mode Profile start location.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA where the infill reference location is at or in rear of the start of the currently supervised SH Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the currently supervised SH Mode Profile.

steps.action: Check the state of the Mode Profile and SH balise group list.
steps.expected: The new SH Mode Profile and associated SH balise group list from the infill MA are accepted and supervised.

test_cases.title: Infill MA with SH Mode Profile: Infill reference in advance of SH start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A valid SH Mode Profile is currently supervised. The train is located before the SH Mode Profile start location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Infill MA containing a new SH Mode Profile and SH balise group list. Infill reference location is in advance of the current SH Mode Profile start location.

steps.action: Receive an infill MA where the infill reference location is in advance of the start of the currently supervised SH Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the new SH Mode Profile and the SH balise group list included in the infill MA.

steps.action: Check the state of the currently supervised SH Mode Profile.
steps.expected: The currently supervised SH Mode Profile remains unchanged and continues to be supervised.

test_cases.title: Temporary EOA and SvL when Mode Profile requires SvL
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A Mode Profile for OS mode is received. The Mode Profile requires a temporary SvL.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile with 'require temporary SvL' flag set. MA with EOA.

steps.action: Receive a Mode Profile that requires a temporary SvL.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start of the Mode Profile as a temporary EOA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) status.
steps.expected: A temporary SvL without release speed is considered at the start of the Mode Profile.

test_cases.title: Temporary EOA and SvL when Mode Profile does not require SvL and MA has LOA at/beyond profile start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A Mode Profile for OS mode is received. The Mode Profile does not require a temporary SvL. The MA defines an LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile with 'no temporary SvL' flag set. MA with LOA located at or beyond the Mode Profile start.

steps.action: Receive a Mode Profile that does not require a temporary SvL, with an MA containing an LOA at or beyond the Mode Profile start.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start of the Mode Profile as a temporary EOA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) status.
steps.expected: A temporary SvL without release speed is considered as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5 as if no LOA had been given (i.e., at the end of overlap, Danger Point, or End of Section).

test_cases.title: Temporary EOA and SvL when Mode Profile does not require SvL and MA has LOA in rear of profile start
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision (FS) mode. A Mode Profile for OS mode is received. The Mode Profile does not require a temporary SvL. The MA defines an LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Mode Profile with 'no temporary SvL' flag set. MA with LOA located in rear of the Mode Profile start.

steps.action: Receive a Mode Profile that does not require a temporary SvL, with an MA containing an LOA in rear of the Mode Profile start.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the start of the Mode Profile as a temporary EOA.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location (SvL) status.
steps.expected: A temporary SvL without release speed is considered at the start of the Mode Profile.

test_cases.title: Replacement of LX information with same identity
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is in a mode where it accepts trackside information (e.g., Full Supervision). The OBU has already received and stored Level Crossing (LX) information with a specific identity (e.g., LX_ID_1) and specific parameters (e.g., unprotected, stop required, speed 30 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new LX information message with the same identity (LX_ID_1) but different parameters (e.g., protected, or different speed/stop requirements).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the stored LX data or the resulting supervision behavior (e.g., via debug interface or driver display).

steps.action: Verify that the OBU currently holds the initial LX information for identity LX_ID_1.
steps.expected: The OBU displays or internally stores the initial LX parameters (e.g., unprotected, stop required).

steps.action: Inject a new LX information message via the trackside interface with the same identity LX_ID_1 but different parameters (e.g., protected).
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new message.

steps.action: Check the stored LX information for identity LX_ID_1 in the OBU.
steps.expected: The stored LX information reflects the new parameters (e.g., protected). The old parameters are no longer present for this identity.

test_cases.title: Independence of LX information with different identities
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has stored LX information for identity LX_ID_A and LX_ID_B.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new LX information message for identity LX_ID_A with updated parameters.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of stored LX data for multiple identities.

steps.action: Verify that the OBU holds LX information for both LX_ID_A and LX_ID_B.
steps.expected: Both LX_ID_A and LX_ID_B are present with their respective initial parameters.

steps.action: Inject a new LX information message for identity LX_ID_A with updated parameters.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new message for LX_ID_A.

steps.action: Check the stored LX information for both LX_ID_A and LX_ID_B.
steps.expected: LX_ID_A reflects the new parameters. LX_ID_B remains unchanged with its original parameters.

test_cases.title: Phishing-resistant authentication option is available and functional at AAL2
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. The system is configured to require AAL2 for this user role.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials (username/password) and a registered phishing-resistant authenticator (e.g., FIDO2/WebAuthn security key or platform authenticator).
test_cases.assumptions: The phishing-resistant authenticator is already bound to the user account during enrollment.

steps.action: Navigate to the VBP login page and enter the valid company representative username and password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first factor and prompts for the second factor, displaying an option to use a phishing-resistant authenticator (e.g., 'Use Security Key' or 'Touch ID/Face ID' if platform-bound).

steps.action: Select the phishing-resistant authentication option and complete the authentication using the registered authenticator (e.g., insert security key and touch it, or use biometric prompt on platform device).
steps.expected: The system verifies the cryptographic challenge-response, confirms the authenticator is bound to the correct verifier (channel or name binding), and grants access to the portal dashboard.

steps.action: Verify the session state in the system logs or user profile.
steps.expected: The session is marked as authenticated at AAL2 using a phishing-resistant method.

test_cases.title: Phishing-resistant authentication rejects unbound or invalid authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. A phishing-resistant authenticator is registered for a *different* user account.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials (username/password) and a phishing-resistant authenticator bound to a different account.

steps.action: Navigate to the VBP login page and enter the valid company representative username and password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the first factor and prompts for the second factor.

steps.action: Select the phishing-resistant authentication option and attempt to authenticate using the authenticator bound to a different account.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt, displaying an error message indicating the authenticator is not recognized or not bound to this account. Access is denied.

test_cases.title: Phishing-resistant authentication option is presented as a distinct choice from non-phishing-resistant methods
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with AAL2 access rights. The account has both a password and a phishing-resistant authenticator bound.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid company representative credentials.

steps.action: Navigate to the VBP login page and enter the valid company representative username and password.
steps.expected: The system displays the second-factor selection screen.

steps.action: Inspect the available authentication options on the second-factor screen.
steps.expected: At least one option is explicitly labeled or identifiable as a phishing-resistant method (e.g., 'Security Key', 'FIDO2', 'WebAuthn'). This option is distinct from any non-phishing-resistant options (like SMS OTP, if present, though AAL2 requires phishing-resistant, so it should be the primary or only compliant option).

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with multi-factor authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a multi-factor authenticator (e.g., a hardware token with biometric activation).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid multi-factor authenticator credentials.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the multi-factor authenticator input.

steps.action: Provide the valid multi-factor authenticator credentials (e.g., insert token and provide biometric scan).
steps.expected: The system successfully authenticates the user and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication with combination of two separate factors
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a combination of a physical authenticator (e.g., OTP app) and a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and valid OTP code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the password.

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second factor (OTP).

steps.action: Enter the valid OTP code from the physical authenticator.
steps.expected: The system successfully authenticates the user and grants access to the portal.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with single factor only
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a combination of a physical authenticator (e.g., OTP app) and a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password only.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the password.

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second factor (OTP).

steps.action: Do not provide the second factor and attempt to proceed or submit the form without the OTP.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating that a second factor is required.

test_cases.title: AAL2 authentication failure with invalid second factor
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account is registered and configured for AAL2 authentication using a combination of a physical authenticator (e.g., OTP app) and a password.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid password and invalid OTP code.
test_cases.assumptions: The system is configured to enforce AAL2 for company representatives.

steps.action: Initiate the login process for a company representative account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for the password.

steps.action: Enter the valid password.
steps.expected: The system accepts the password and prompts for the second factor (OTP).

steps.action: Enter an invalid OTP code.
steps.expected: The system rejects the authentication attempt and displays an error message indicating an invalid second factor.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun inaktivite zaman aşımında sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi (örneğin 1 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinden daha kısa bir süre boyunca (örneğin 30 dakika) hiçbir işlem yapmadan oturumu bekletir.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif kalır ve kullanıcı sayfaya erişebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinden daha uzun bir süre boyunca (örneğin 1 saat 1 dakika) hiçbir işlem yapmadan oturumu bekletir.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır. Kullanıcı, oturumun sona erdiğine dair bir bildirim alır veya sonraki işlemde yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir.

test_cases.title: AAL2 oturumunun genel zaman aşımında sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan genel zaman aşımı süresi (örneğin 24 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için genel zaman aşımı süresinin 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra genel zaman aşımı süresinden daha kısa bir süre boyunca (örneğin 12 saat) düzenli olarak işlem yaparak oturumu aktif tutar.
steps.expected: Oturum aktif kalır ve kullanıcı sayfaya erişebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra genel zaman aşımı süresinden daha uzun bir süre boyunca (örneğin 24 saat 1 dakika) düzenli olarak işlem yaparak oturumu aktif tutar.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır. Kullanıcı, oturumun sona erdiğine dair bir bildirim alır veya sonraki işlemde yeniden kimlik doğrulaması istenir.

test_cases.title: Oturum aktivitesinin inaktivite zaman aşımını sıfırlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı süresi (örneğin 1 saat) yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinin 1 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra 50 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Oturum hâlâ aktiftir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, 50. dakikada bir sayfa yenileme veya form doldurma işlemi gerçekleştirir.
steps.expected: Inaktivite zaman aşımı sayacı sıfırlanır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, işlem yaptığı andan itibaren 50 dakika boyunca tekrar hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Oturum hâlâ aktiftir (toplam 100 dakika geçmesine rağmen, son aktiviteden itibaren 50 dakika geçtiği için).

steps.action: Kullanıcı, son aktiviteden itibaren 1 saat 1 dakika boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır.

test_cases.title: Başarılı yeniden kimlik doğrulamanın her iki zaman aşımını sıfırlaması
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite (1 saat) ve genel (24 saat) zaman aşımı süreleri yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımının 1 saat, genel zaman aşımının 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, oturum açtıktan sonra 23 saat 50 dakika boyunca düzenli olarak işlem yaparak oturumu aktif tutar.
steps.expected: Oturum hâlâ aktiftir, ancak genel zaman aşımı yaklaşıyor.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, sistem tarafından istenen yeniden kimlik doğrulamasını (reauthentication) başarıyla tamamlar.
steps.expected: Hem inaktivite hem de genel zaman aşımı sayaçları sıfırlanır.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yeniden kimlik doğrulamasından sonra 24 saat 1 dakika boyunca düzenli olarak işlem yaparak oturumu aktif tutar.
steps.expected: Oturum sonlandırılır, çünkü sıfırlanan genel zaman aşımı süresi dolmuştur.

test_cases.title: Inaktivite zaman aşımında tek faktörlü yeniden kimlik doğrulama seçeneği
test_cases.preconditions: Kullanıcı AAL2 kimlik doğrulamasını başarıyla tamamlamış ve aktif bir oturuma sahiptir. VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te tanımlanan inaktivite zaman aşımı (1 saat) dolmuş, ancak genel zaman aşımı (24 saat) henüz dolmamıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP Yazılım Tasarım Belgesi §14'te AAL2 için inaktivite zaman aşımının 1 saat, genel zaman aşımının 24 saat olduğu varsayılmaktadır. NIST SP 800-63B-4 §2.2.3'e göre, inaktivite zaman aşımı dolmuş ancak genel zaman aşımı dolmamışsa, doğrulayıcı yalnızca şifre veya biyometrik karşılaştırma ile yeniden kimlik doğrulama yapmaya izin verebilir.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, inaktivite zaman aşımı süresinden (1 saatten) daha uzun bir süre boyunca hiçbir işlem yapmaz.
steps.expected: Oturum inaktivite nedeniyle askıya alınır veya sonlandırılır, ancak genel zaman aşımı dolmadığı için yeniden kimlik doğrulama seçeneği sunulur.

steps.action: Kullanıcı, yalnızca şifresini (veya biyometrik verisini) girerek yeniden kimlik doğrulama yapar.
steps.expected: Yeniden kimlik doğrulama başarılı olur ve oturum yeniden etkinleştirilir. Tam AAL2 kimlik doğrulaması (çok faktörlü) istenmez.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to representative upon account recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with at least one valid notification address (e.g., email). The account is in a state where recovery is possible (e.g., locked or authenticators lost).
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials (e.g., recovery code) for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The notification system is operational and capable of sending emails to the test address.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully, and the account is restored to an active state.

steps.action: Check the notification inbox (e.g., email) associated with the representative's account.
steps.expected: A notification email is received indicating that an account recovery event occurred. The email contains clear instructions and contact information as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to designee upon account recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a designated notification address (designee) configured in the account settings. The account is in a state where recovery is possible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: The designee's notification address is valid and monitored for the test.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully.

steps.action: Check the notification channel (e.g., email) associated with the designee's address.
steps.expected: A notification is received by the designee indicating that an account recovery event occurred for the representative account.

test_cases.title: Notification sent to all valid non-postal addresses upon recovery
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account has multiple valid notification addresses configured (e.g., two email addresses). The account is in a state where recovery is possible.
test_cases.test_inputs: Valid recovery credentials for the representative account.
test_cases.assumptions: All configured email addresses are active and monitored.

steps.action: Initiate the account recovery process for the company representative account using valid recovery credentials.
steps.expected: The recovery process completes successfully.

steps.action: Check the inboxes for all configured non-postal notification addresses.
steps.expected: A notification is received at each of the configured non-postal addresses, as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6 which states notifications SHALL be sent to all notification addresses except postal addresses.

test_cases.title: Bildirimlerin kayıtlı tüm dijital adreslere gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı oluşturulmuştur. Hesaba bir e-posta adresi, bir telefon numarası (SMS) ve bir posta adresi kayıtlıdır.
test_cases.assumptions: Hesapta en az bir dijital bildirim adresi (e-posta veya telefon) bulunmaktadır.

steps.action: Hesapla ilgili bir bildirim olayı (örneğin, yeni bir oturum açma veya hesap değişikliği) tetiklenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, kayıtlı e-posta adresine ve telefon numarasına bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Gönderilen bildirimlerin hedef adresleri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Bildirimler e-posta ve SMS olarak alınır. Posta adresine herhangi bir fiziksel mektup veya bildirim gönderilmez.

test_cases.title: Sadece posta adresi kayıtlıysa bildirimin posta adresine gönderilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı oluşturulmuştur. Hesaba yalnızca bir posta adresi kayıtlıdır; e-posta veya telefon numarası yoktur.
test_cases.assumptions: NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.6'ya göre, başka bir dijital adres yoksa posta adresine bildirim gönderilir.

steps.action: Hesapla ilgili bir bildirim olayı tetiklenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, kayıtlı posta adresine fiziksel bir bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Dijital kanallara (e-posta/SMS) gönderim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Dijital kanallara bildirim gönderilmez, çünkü kayıtlı dijital adres yoktur.

test_cases.title: Birden fazla dijital adresin varlığında posta adresinin hariç tutulması
test_cases.preconditions: Sistemde bir şirket temsilcisi hesabı oluşturulmuştur. Hesaba iki farklı e-posta adresi, bir telefon numarası ve bir posta adresi kayıtlıdır.

steps.action: Hesapla ilgili bir bildirim olayı tetiklenir.
steps.expected: Sistem, her iki e-posta adresine ve telefon numarasına bildirim gönderir.

steps.action: Posta adresine gönderim durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Posta adresine bildirim gönderilmez, çünkü en az bir dijital bildirim adresi mevcuttur.

test_cases.title: Vatandaş oturumunun e-Devlet belirteç geçerlilik süresinden bağımsızlığı
test_cases.preconditions: Vatandaş, e-Devlet üzerinden başarılı bir şekilde VBP'ye giriş yapmıştır. VBP oturumu aktiftir.
test_cases.assumptions: VBP oturum zaman aşımı süresi, e-Devlet belirteç geçerlilik penceresinden (5 dakika) belirgin şekilde uzundur (örneğin 30 dakika).

steps.action: Vatandaşın VBP oturumunun aktif olduğu doğrulanır.
steps.expected: Vatandaş, VBP'de oturum açılmış olarak görünür ve yetkili işlevlere erişebilir.

steps.action: Sistem saati, e-Devlet belirtecinin geçerlilik penceresinin (5 dakika) dolmasını sağlayacak şekilde ileri alınır.
steps.expected: VBP, oturumu sonlandırmaz. Vatandaş hâlâ oturum açılmış olarak kalır.

steps.action: Vatandaş, VBP'de bir sayfa yeniler veya yetkili bir işlevi (örneğin başvuru durumunu görüntüleme) tetikler.
steps.expected: İşlem başarıyla tamamlanır. Oturum sonlandırma veya yeniden kimlik doğrulama isteği yapılmaz.

test_cases.title: VBP'nin e-Devlet'e gönderdiği federasyon isteğinin içeriği
test_cases.preconditions: VBP ve e-Devlet arasında federasyon işlemi başlatılabilir durumda olmalıdır.

steps.action: VBP üzerinden bir federasyon işlemi başlatılır.
steps.expected: VBP, e-Devlet'e bir federasyon isteği gönderir.

test_cases.title: Changing pre-registered phone number triggers binding process
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with a pre-registered telephone number. The user is authenticated in a session with sufficient assurance level (AAL) to perform account management actions.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new valid telephone number for the company representative.
test_cases.assumptions: The system implements the binding process as defined in NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2, which includes generating a binding code and verifying it.

steps.action: Navigate to the account settings and select the option to change the pre-registered telephone number for SMS codes.
steps.expected: The system initiates the authenticator binding process rather than directly updating the number. A binding code generation or verification step is presented.

steps.action: Complete the binding process by verifying the new telephone number using the generated binding code or secret.
steps.expected: The binding process completes successfully. The new telephone number is saved as the pre-registered number for SMS codes.

steps.action: Request an SMS authentication code for a new login or sensitive action.
steps.expected: The SMS code is sent to the newly registered telephone number.

test_cases.title: Direct update of phone number without binding process is rejected
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The user is authenticated.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system enforces that phone number changes must go through the binding process and does not allow direct API or UI updates that bypass this flow.

steps.action: Attempt to update the pre-registered telephone number via a direct API call or UI field that does not trigger the binding workflow (if such a path exists for testing purposes, or by simulating a bypass attempt).
steps.expected: The system rejects the change. An error message is displayed indicating that the binding process must be used to change the authenticator.

steps.action: Verify the current pre-registered telephone number in the account settings.
steps.expected: The original telephone number remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Binding process requires authentication at required AAL
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists. The user is authenticated at a lower assurance level than required for binding a new authenticator (e.g., AAL1 when AAL2 is required for binding).
test_cases.test_inputs: A new telephone number.
test_cases.assumptions: The system requires authentication at the maximum AAL currently available or the maximum AAL for the new authenticator, whichever is lower, as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Initiate the process to change the pre-registered telephone number.
steps.expected: The system prompts the user to re-authenticate at the required higher assurance level before proceeding with the binding process.

steps.action: Complete the re-authentication at the required level.
steps.expected: The binding process for the new telephone number becomes available.

test_cases.title: Binding a second authenticator to an account with one existing authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with one active authenticator bound to it. The user is authenticated at the maximum AAL available for the account.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new, valid authenticator suitable for the account's AAL.
test_cases.assumptions: The system supports binding multiple authenticators as per NIST SP 800-63B-4 §4.1.2.1.

steps.action: Initiate the process to add a new authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system prompts for authentication at the required AAL level.

steps.action: Complete the authentication and register the new authenticator.
steps.expected: The new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

steps.action: View the list of authenticators associated with the account.
steps.expected: Both the original and the new authenticator are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Binding a third authenticator to an account with two existing authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with two active authenticators bound to it. The user is authenticated at the maximum AAL available for the account.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new, valid authenticator suitable for the account's AAL.
test_cases.assumptions: The system allows more than two authenticators to be bound.

steps.action: Initiate the process to add a third authenticator to the account.
steps.expected: The system allows the addition process to proceed.

steps.action: Complete the authentication and register the new authenticator.
steps.expected: The third authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

steps.action: View the list of authenticators associated with the account.
steps.expected: All three authenticators are listed as active.

test_cases.title: Binding an authenticator when the account has no existing authenticators
test_cases.preconditions: A company representative account exists with no authenticators bound to it. The user is in the enrollment or initial setup phase.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new, valid authenticator.
test_cases.assumptions: The system requires at least one authenticator for account access, but the binding process for the first authenticator follows the same multi-authenticator logic or a specific initial binding flow that permits subsequent additions.

steps.action: Attempt to bind a second authenticator without having a first one bound (simulating a state where the user tries to add a second one directly if the UI allows, or verifying the system handles the 'first' binding correctly as part of the multi-auth capability).
steps.expected: The system either treats this as the initial binding (which is allowed) or, if the test specifically targets the 'multiple' aspect, verifies that the system does not crash and correctly establishes the first binding, allowing a second to be added subsequently. *Note: Since the requirement is about permitting multiple, the error case is attempting to add a second when the first is invalid or the process is interrupted.* Let's refine the error case to be more specific to the 'multiple' constraint or a failure in the process.

test_cases.title: Binding authenticator when account AAL is lower than authenticator AAL

steps.action: Provide valid AAL1 credentials.
steps.expected: Authentication succeeds and the binding process proceeds.

steps.action: Complete the binding of the new authenticator.
steps.expected: The new authenticator is successfully bound to the account.

steps.expected: Authentication succeeds and the binding process proceeds.

steps.action: Complete the binding of the new authenticator.

test_cases.title: Binding authenticator with insufficient authentication level

test_cases.title: Notification sent via independent mechanism upon adding authenticator
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists with at least one active authenticator. The representative's contact details (e.g., email address) are registered and valid in the system.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new authenticator (e.g., a new security key or OTP device) to be bound to the account.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'independent mechanism' is defined as an out-of-band channel such as email or SMS, distinct from the web session used for binding.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal as the company representative using the existing authenticator.
steps.expected: The representative is successfully authenticated and can access account settings.

steps.action: Initiate the process to add a new authenticator to the account and complete the binding procedure successfully.
steps.expected: The new authenticator is listed as active in the account settings. The binding transaction completes without error.

steps.action: Check the independent notification channel (e.g., the registered email inbox) for a message regarding the new authenticator.
steps.expected: A notification message is received indicating that a new authenticator has been added to the account. The message is sent via a channel independent of the web session (e.g., email).

test_cases.title: Notification mechanism is independent of the binding session
test_cases.preconditions: A valid company representative account exists. The representative's email address is registered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A new authenticator to be bound.
test_cases.assumptions: The system logs the source IP and session ID of the binding transaction and the delivery method of the notification.

steps.action: Log in to the VBP portal and record the session ID and IP address of the current session.
steps.expected: The session is active and details are recorded.

steps.action: Add a new authenticator to the account within the same session.
steps.expected: The authenticator is bound successfully.

steps.action: Verify the notification delivery logs or the notification content to confirm the delivery channel.
steps.expected: The notification is delivered via an out-of-band mechanism (e.g., email) and is not dependent on the active web session for delivery. The notification is not merely a UI toast or in-session message.
